exposure: Birth asphyxia (8 min umbilical cord occlusion)
outcome: Blood cytokine responses to ex vivo bacterial stimulation
cohort: The study included near-term pig fetuses (98% gestation) delivered by caesarean section, categorized into birth asphyxia (ASP) or non-occluded control (CON) groups, and further randomized to receive plasma supplementation or a vehicle.
finding: Dietary plasma supplementation improved survival, gut functions, and immunity in both normal and asphyxiated newborn piglets.
